source_caption:
🎥🎬: Rolling Loud The Movie (2026)

A father just wanted to give his son an unforgettable experience—but sneaking a 13-year-old into Rolling Loud Miami turns into complete chaos when they get separated in the middle of the festival.

Now, Owen Wilson’s overprotective dad has to navigate the madness of one of the world’s biggest music festivals to find his son, leading to an unexpected adventure filled with laughs, music, and unforgettable moments.

Featuring Matt Rife, Travis Scott, Sexyy Red, Ty Dolla $ign, Ski Mask The Slump God and more.

🎬 In theaters October 2, 2026

source_details.synopsis: Rolling Loud: The Movie is a 2026 American comedy film written and directed by Jeremy Garelick. The film stars Owen Wilson, Matt Rife, Christine Ko, Christian Convery, Henry Winkler, and Jolene Blalock alongside musical guests such as Sexyy Red, Ty Dolla Sign, Ski Mask the Slump God, and Travis Scott.
